story.vex: Outsource your judgment along with your workload. That's how I get in. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: the contract keeps judgment calls in-house and monitoring outsourced, exactly where each belongs. Astro: "Work, yes. Judgment, ours."

MSSP CONTRACT PROPOSAL
-------------------------
function-247-monitoring     round-the-clock watching of security alerts
function-access-decisions   deciding who gets access to the starmap and other sensitive files
function-patch-installs     installing routine, vendor-released security patches on standard systems

steps.title: Read the proposal
steps.body: Rivet: "Read all three before deciding any of them." `type mssp-proposal.txt`.

steps.title: Decide what stays and what goes
steps.body: Astro: "Constant coverage, routine work — safe to outsource. A judgment call about our own priorities — stays with us." Classify all three functions.
